tagline.en: App-first European eSIM brand, prepaid plans from EUR 3.99
tagline.zh: App 优先的欧洲 eSIM 品牌，€3.99 起

description.en: GoMoWorld is an app-first European eSIM brand covering 200+ destinations, with prepaid plans from EUR 3.99 and an average of two networks per country for coverage redundancy.
description.zh: GoMoWorld 是 App 优先的欧洲 eSIM 品牌，覆盖 200+ 目的地，预付套餐 €3.99 起，平均每个国家接入两条网络以保障覆盖。

network.en: ~2 networks per country on average (official claim)
network.zh: 官方称平均每国约 2 条网络

zh: 平均每国约 2 条网络

details.en:
GoMoWorld is a European, app-first eSIM brand covering 200+ destinations, advertising "an average of two networks per country" for coverage redundancy and prepaid plans from EUR 3.99 (rendered from the homepage and plans page, 2026-11-10; plansFrom converted to about $4.30).

Product shape: fixed prepaid packs, bought and activated entirely in-app - the website has no web checkout and does not expose a per-GB catalog, so comparing prices requires installing the app or reading store screenshots.

Who it fits: light travellers who prefer a European brand and do not mind an app-only flow.

Notes: entry packs are small; the dual-network redundancy is an official claim, not an independent measurement; and store ratings vary notably between app stores - check recent reviews before buying.
details.zh:
GoMoWorld 是一家欧洲 App 优先的 eSIM 品牌，覆盖 200+ 目的地，官方宣传「平均每国接入约 2 条网络」做覆盖冗余，预付套餐 €3.99 起（2026-11-10 渲染官网首页与套餐页实核；plansFrom 按 ≈$4.30 折算）。

产品形态：定额预付包，购买与激活全部在 App 内完成，官网没有网页结算通道，也未在网页展开逐 GB 价目——比价时需要装 App 或看应用商店截图。

适合人群：轻度出行、喜欢欧洲品牌、不介意纯 App 流程的用户。

注意：入门包容量小；双网络冗余是官方口径而非独立实测；同一品牌在不同应用商店的评分差异较大，购买前建议翻近期评价。

补充：其「每国约 2 条网络」的冗余设计对城市旅行通常够用，但偏远地区单网故障时没有第三备选；跨区行程建议在 App 内检查目的地清单后再下单。
